ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Health Sciences Information Services and Resources] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students (including Bioinformatics majors) may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu); Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu.
